title: The Quencher's Course
summary: A course that carries a student from quenching one hostile spark to cancelling a whole wave of soul force aimed at a group.

title: Handbook of Opposed Frequencies
summary: A handbook on setting the frequency of the user against a hostile one until the interference between them leaves only calm.

title: A Workbook of Unmade Spells
summary: A workbook on pulling the loose thread of a hostile soul technique so that the whole of it comes undone in the air.

title: The Null Reader's Guide
summary: A guide to reading the null point of every hostile soul technique and standing in it so that no harm can arrive.

title: Course in Dampened Souls
summary: A course in muffling hostile soul force until it dies away and in smothering a foe's technique before it can take shape.
